messages:
emma: promo stuck during CI prefetch. deploy-bot is retrying but getting 504s from cache-service. change window open (~22m).
ryan: confirmed. artifact exists in registry; only prefetch failing. attempts at 7/10 and backing off.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion job=promo-998 state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=7/10 last_error=504 Gateway Timeout. next_retry_in=45s.
infra-bot: alert: cache-service frontends showing high latency and queued S3 proxy requests. creating incident INC-2026-03-cache-77.
claire: options: 1) wait (risk missing window), 2) abort promo and retry later, 3) manual promote pin+skip-prefetch. I prefer manual if infra can't fix in 10m.
marc: agree with manual pin. we should require immediate smoke + short canary and a rollback target in the release notes.
emma: if we go manual, use image sha256:aa11bb22cc. also require smoke e2e and 2% canary for 30m.
ryan: deploy-bot supports `--skip-cache-prefetch`. tested it on staging last week. command: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:aa11bb22cc --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-prefetch-1746`. infra ok?
infra-bot: infra approves manual promote while we continue rolling restarts of proxy workers. will post health updates.
marc: approve. emma, can you update release notes after promote?
emma: yes, i'll add the why + rollback target sha256:dd99ee88ff and instructions.
ryan: kicking manual promote now. job promo-999 queued.
deploy-bot: update: promo-999 started. parameters: skip_prefetch=true tag=manual-skip-prefetch-1746. stage=activation -> in-progress.
deploy-bot: success: promo-999 completed. prod now running image sha256:aa11bb22cc. label=manual_promo tag=manual-skip-prefetch-1746.
emma: starting smoke and enabling 2% canary. watching p95 latency and 5xx panels.
claire: adding release note: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch 504s. Promoted sha256:aa11bb22cc; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target sha256:dd99ee88ff." pushed to release doc.
ryan: rollback playbook added to release doc with immediate revert command and monitoring checks. support on pager.
infra-bot: rolling restarts reduced 504s from ~19% -> ~2% after 3 minutes. will follow up with postmortem (suspect S3 proxy thread leak).
emma: pinning this thread on the release doc. follow-ups: (1) add a prefetch circuit-breaker in deploy-bot to auto-fall back to manual path after N retries, (2) document `--skip-cache-prefetch` usage in runbook, (3) postmortem for cache-service.
marc: good. closing promo hold while canary runs. monitoring window set for 30m. :white_check_mark:
